claims.text: The powder feedstock is cobalt-free AlCrFeNiSi.
HIP of additively manufactured AlCrFeNiSi reduces porosity.
HIP of additively manufactured AlCrFeNiSi reduces residual stresses.
HIP removes defects in additively manufactured AlCrFeNiSi.
HIP relieves residual stresses in additively manufactured AlCrFeNiSi.
Defect removal and residual-stress relief enhance the density and mechanical properties of AlCrFeNiSi.
Additive manufacturing followed by HIP increases the yield strength of AlCrFeNiSi relative to conventionally fabricated AlCrFeNiSi.
Additive manufacturing followed by HIP increases the toughness of AlCrFeNiSi relative to conventionally fabricated AlCrFeNiSi.

contradictions.description: The predicted outcome uses conventionally fabricated AlCrFeNiSi as the comparator, but the falsification experiment compares HIP-treated additive-manufactured samples with untreated additive-manufactured samples. Thus, the proposed experiment does not directly test the stated baseline-relative prediction.
